data.one_liner: Generates a detailed OSS license list from pubspec.yaml and lock files.
data.what_it_does: The package reads your project's pubspec and lock files to produce a comprehensive list of open‑source licenses used. It also supports the `--split-sdk-licenses` flag and deduplicates entries.
use_when: You need to include an OSS license list in your app for compliance
You want an easy way to generate license data during build or CI
avoid_when: You require a fully maintained solution (this package is deprecated)
You need runtime UI components for displaying licenses
weaknesses: Adds no extra functionality beyond re‑exporting

alternatives.name: dart_pubspec_licenses
alternatives.why_pick_it: Directly provides the same functionality without the deprecated wrapper
